data.define: Used to tell someone to feel better.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cheer up' to someone grieving.
misuse.why: It sounds like you dismiss their pain.

data.l1_hook: Elle a l'air triste. "Cheer up" ! Que faire maintenant ?
data.l1_ex: "Cheer up", on mange de la pizza !

native.tip: “cheer up” = remonte le moral. Exemple: “Cheer up, we're having pizza!”
